procedures.name: Dental Implants
procedures.warranty: Lifetime Warranty on Swiss Straumann / Nobel Biocare Implants
procedures.description: Permanent titanium tooth root replacement with computer-guided placement. Includes 3D CBCT imaging and custom zirconia crown.
treatment_stages: Stage 1: 3D CBCT Scan & Computer-Guided Titanium Implant Placement
Stage 3: Custom Abutment & Zirconia Crown Placement
procedures.contraindications: Uncontrolled diabetes, active heavy smoking (>20 cigarettes/day), or severe unmanaged osteoporosis require medical clearance.

procedures.name: Invisalign Clear Aligners
procedures.warranty: 5-Year Guarantee with free tray refinements & Vivera retainers
procedures.description: US-FDA approved transparent removable aligners for discreet teeth straightening without metal wires.
treatment_stages: Stage 1: 3D iTero Digital Intraoral Scan & ClinCheck Video Simulation
Stage 2: Delivery of Custom SmartTrack Aligner Trays (changed every 10-14 days)
Stage 3: Final Alignment & Vivera Nighttime Retainers
procedures.contraindications: Severe skeletal jaw discrepancies may require combined orthognathic surgery.

procedures.name: Full Mouth Rehabilitation
procedures.description: Complete restoration of severely worn, missing, or broken teeth using All-on-4 / All-on-6 computer-guided implant bridges.
treatment_stages: Stage 1: Full-jaw 3D CBCT Diagnostic Modeling & Immediate Fixed Provisional Bridge
Stage 3: Monolithic Zirconia Permanent Bridge Placement

procedures.name: Single-Visit Root Canal Treatment
procedures.warranty: 10-Year Structural Integrity Guarantee (when paired with Zirconia Crown)
procedures.description: Pain-free rotary endodontic treatment completed under magnification to eliminate deep dental infection.
treatment_stages: Stage 1: Local Anesthesia & Rubber Dam Isolation
Stage 2: Rotary Cleaning, Disinfection & Gutta-Percha Canal Obturation
Stage 3: Fiber Post Core Build-up & CAD/CAM Crown Scan

procedures.name: Hollywood Smile Makeover & Veneers
procedures.description: Ultra-thin custom E-Max porcelain veneers designed to correct gap, discoloration, and tooth shape misalignment.
treatment_stages: Stage 1: Digital Smile Design (DSD) Mock-up Preview
Stage 2: Minimal Enamel Preparation & Digital Intraoral Scan
Stage 3: E-Max Porcelain Bonding & Occlusal Balancing

faqs.question: Do you accept health insurance for dental treatments?
faqs.answer: Yes! We support cashless treatment & reimbursement assistance for major health insurers including Star Health, HDFC ERGO, ICICI Lombard, and corporate TPA policies for surgical procedures & hospital-based extractions.

faqs.question: What flexible payment and EMI options do you offer?
faqs.answer: We offer 0% interest monthly EMI plans over 3, 6, 12, or 18 months for treatments above ₹15,000 via Bajaj Finserv, Credit Cards, and LiquiLoans.

faqs.question: Is parking available at the clinic?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide free dedicated basement parking and complimentary valet parking for all our patients at our 100 Feet Road Koramangala facility.

faqs.question: Are treatments painful?
faqs.answer: All surgical and root canal procedures are performed under painless computer-controlled local anesthesia or conscious sedation, ensuring 100% comfort during treatment.

faqs.question: What are the immediate post-treatment care guidelines?
faqs.answer: For extractions/implants: bite gently on the gauze for 45 minutes, avoid hot food/drinks for 24 hours, do not spit forcefully, and take prescribed anti-inflammatory medications as instructed.
